units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 4:4:3">Y. Ter. IV, 42ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>הוה יליף תָּרֵים חד וכ׳</he> if he was used to give as T’rumah one-fiftieth &c.; <he>כד הוא תרים חד וכ׳</he> when he gives one-fortieth, he deprives himself of six quarters (of a Kab); a. e.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:10">Esth. R. to III, 6</cite> <he>רישיך מְתוּרָם חלף וכ׳</he> (Hebr. form) thy head shall be lifted (removed) in place of their heads.
